I'm on the AI Core team at [Posit](https://posit.co/), where I work on AI for data science. I also co-author the [Posit AI newsletter](https://posit.co/blog/?post_tag=ai-newsletter) with Simon Couch.

Previously, I helped build [Posit Academy](https://posit.co/products/enterprise/academy/) and co-taught an introductory data science class at Stanford, where we created [open educational materials](http://dcl-docs.stanford.edu/home/) on data visualization and programming in R.

I studied [Symbolic Systems](https://symsys.stanford.edu/) at Stanford (BS/MS). For my master's thesis, I worked with Hyowon Gweon and Sophie Bridgers in the [Social Learning Lab](https://sll.stanford.edu/), studying how young children use information about others' failures to decide how to help.
